name: handover
title: Draft role handover
for_each: select id,code from roles order by code

sections.title: Role and cover
sections.note: Role owner to confirm dates, access and delegated authority. No appointment is made by this document.

sections.title: Readiness evidence
sections.sql: select person,readiness,interest,assessed_on,evidence,assessor,blocking_actions,usable from successor_status where role_id=$1 order by person_code

sections.title: Development commitments
sections.sql: select d.code,d.task,d.owner,d.due,d.status,d.blocking,d.evidence from development d join successors s on s.id=d.successor_id where s.role_id=$1 order by d.due

name: development-plan
title: Draft successor development plan
for_each: select s.id,r.code || '-' || p.code as code from successors s join roles r on r.id=s.role_id join people p on p.id=s.person_id order by r.code,p.code

sections.title: Agreed actions
sections.sql: select code,task,owner,due,status,blocking,evidence from development where successor_id=$1 order by due
